entries.question: Do frozen A3 reports + round-003/002 documentation already answer B13 questions on SIFO items/subgroup uncertainty and Fafo recipient selection?

entries.queryOrDocument: A3/data.json gaps A3-G001/G002/G006/G007; private SIFO/Fafo PDFs; round-003 D-S005; sokelogg A3-L001/L003/L012
entries.result: Prior gaps remain open. Re-verified SIFO Tabell 2-1 totals, Figur 4-3/4-4 p-only uncertainty, Vedlegg 6 item/scoring without wave item distributions; Fafo org 49% vs recipient mapping without per-site response share; SIFO PDF hash matches round-003 not A3-S001 string.

entries.question: Is there a published SIFO technical annex beyond rapport 7-2025 Vedlegg 6 with item-level wave distributions, subgroup N, weights, and SE/CI for Figur 4-3/4-4?
entries.channel: Web search of named public documents; ODA handle fetch attempt
entries.queryOrDocument: SIFO-rapport 7-2025 Familiefattigdom teknisk vedlegg matsikkerhet item svarfordeling; SIFO matsikkerhetsindeks item-ordlyd site:oslomet.no; https://hdl.handle.net/11250/3213110
entries.result: Search returned the same public PDF mirrors (Parat/UNICEF) and news summaries; OsloMet publication lists point to related Trygghetsbarometer reports, not a separate item-wave distribution annex for Figur 4-3/4-4. ODA handle fetch timed out; no new technical annex retrieved. Footnote 8 in rapport 7-2025 still points to Kempson/Poppe/Gyüre wave reports for sample precision—not opened as new broad search beyond named stop.
entries.stopReason: B13 stop/search rule: after named channels, deliver precise gap + owner; do not reformulate broad search

entries.question: Does Fafo publish national recipient population frame or per-site response shares beyond rapport 2026:01 method text/appendices?
entries.channel: Web search + frozen Fafo PDF method §§2.1–2.2 and Vedlegg 1–3 titles
entries.queryOrDocument: Fafo-rapport 2026:01 Matutdeling mottakerutvalg svarandel metodevedlegg 20952; fafo.no publication page
entries.result: Public pages restate 1906 respondents / 31 sites and org-survey 49% response. Method text explicitly: no registration of answer share per site; cannot infer full recipient population. Vedlegg 1–3 are questionnaires/org lists. No separate national-frame annex found.
entries.stopReason: Stop rule: no national prevalence from distribution sample; exact missing fields registered for owner request
